why: The FVS is a named, adoptable surgical simulation and skills-assessment system rather than a general instructional element; its simulation and hands-on components are instances of existing elements.
name: Fundamentals of Vaginal Surgery (FVS) simulation system
product_description: A 3D-printed vaginal-surgery task trainer with disposable simulated inserts, standardized instructional video, timed procedural tasks, and error-based scoring for teaching and assessing Ob/Gyn residents' basic surgical skills.
